description: Aggregated statistics of a game over its last 2000 draws: most and least frequent numbers, longest absences, even/odd split, sum range and top pairs. Available for: primitiva, bonoloto, euromillones, gordo, eurodreams, lototurf. Covers the last 2000 draws only; no per-number tables or custom periods.

game.description: Game slug. Call list_games to see them all. Example: "euromillones".

name: get_public_statistics
title: Get aggregated game statistics
